messages:
ian-support: ACME reporting p99 jumped from ~420ms -> ~1.8s on /v1/generate since continuous-batcher config change last night. customer id acme-123, trace acme-20260315-9

deploy-bot: config-change applied: continuous.batcher.timeout_ms: 30 -> 120 (by kevin-ops) at 2026-03-15T23:48Z

kevin-ops: yup, bumped timeout to reduce canceled/partial batches during bursts. didn't expect this p99 effect.

maria-sre: can you paste the trace id + model variant? any tenant overrides? :thinking: 

ian-support: trace id acme-20260315-9, model=redwood/gpt-large-q4, route=generate-tiny-prompts

jules-sre: pulling traces. quick read shows lots of single-token requests held until timeout -> batch_size=1 frequently. KV cache miss spike too. looks like long wait + cold-start-ish inference combined.

kevin-ops: logs snippet from the node:
```
[2026-03-15T23:49:12Z] request=acme-20260315-9 wait_ms=118 batch_size=1 served_by=gpu-12
[2026-03-15T23:49:12Z] request=acme-20260315-9 start_infer=1890ms
[2026-03-15T23:49:12Z] request=acme-20260315-9 finish=2082ms
```

maria-sre: repro plan (short): 1) send 300 single-token requests/sec with acme tenant header 2) set continuous.batcher.timeout_ms=120 in canary 3) measure p95/p99 + batch size distribution

kevin-ops: kicking off canary repro now in us-west2-canary, will report numbers.

jules-sre: quick mitigation options: a) per-tenant override to rollback timeout to 30ms, b) add a max_delay cap for tiny-prompts route (e.g., 40ms), c) enable prefix/KV caching aggressively for acme to cut infer time.

ian-support: customer wants ETA for fix, escalated to enterprise success. what's safest hotfix?

maria-sre: safest hotfix = per-tenant rollback to 30ms (no code change) + enable prefix cache if available. that'll reduce wait and KV miss cost. I'll push the override.

kevin-ops: applied per-tenant override for acme-123, timeout back to 30ms. watching metrics.

oncall-bot: alert: acme-123 p99 anomaly status -> resolved (p99 returned to ~480ms) at 2026-03-16T00:04Z

ian-support: told customer, they confirmed improvement. :thumbsup:

maria-sre: follow-ups: (1) add canary test for tiny-prompt traffic patterns, (2) add unit test to catch large timeout bumps for continuous.batcher, (3) create SRE ticket to add deploy guard. filing SRE-981

kevin-ops: will add a CI warning if continuous.batcher.timeout_ms change > 50ms for any deploy.

ian-support: thanks everyone — closing the customer escalation unless it recurs.
